ezra.4.p1.b1.text: When the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the exiles were building a temple for the LORD, the God of Israel,

ezra.4.p1.b2.text: Let us build with you because, like you, we seek your God

ezra.4.p1.b3.text: You have no part with us in building a house for our God … as Cyrus king of Persia has commanded us.

ezra.4.p2.b1.text: Then the people of the land set out to discourage the people of Judah and make them afraid to build.

ezra.4.p2.b2.text: throughout the reign of Cyrus king of Persia and down to the reign of Darius king of Persia …

ezra.4.p2.b3.text: … They hired counselors against them to frustrate their plans

ezra.4.p2.b4.text: At the beginning of the reign of Xerxes, an accusation was lodged against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

ezra.4.p3.b1.text: Rehum the commander and Shimshai the scribe wrote the letter against Jerusalem to King Artaxerxes as follows:

ezra.4.p3.b2.text: Let it be known to the king that the Jews who came from you to us have returned to Jerusalem. And they are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city …

ezra.4.p3.b3.text: … its walls are restored, they will not pay tribute, duty, or toll, and the royal treasury will suffer.

ezra.4.p3.b4.text: … if this city is rebuilt and its walls are restored, you will have no dominion west of the Euphrates.

ezra.4.p4.b1.text: The letter you sent us has been translated and read in my presence. I issued a decree, and a search was conducted. It was discovered that this city has revolted against kings from ancient times …

ezra.4.p4.b2.text: Now, therefore, issue an order for these men to stop, so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order.

ezra.4.p4.b3.text: When the text of the letter from King Artaxerxes was read to Rehum, Shimshai the scribe, and their associates

ezra.4.p4.b4.text: they went immediately to the Jews in Jerusalem and forcibly stopped them.

ezra.4.p5.b1.text: Thus the construction of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and it remained at a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
